title: Fijate que no
desc: Saying no without ever saying it
setting: A workmate you barely know invites you to something you have no intention of going to.

steps.speaker: Compañero
steps.es: Vaya, ¿venís el domingo al culto con nosotros?
steps.en: So, are you coming to the service with us on Sunday?

options.es: Qué bueno que me tomás en cuenta.
options.en: How good of you to think of me.
options.feedback: Every no here starts with the thanks. It buys you the whole rest of the sentence.
Clear, and clean, and about twice as cold as you mean it.

options.en: I do not believe in that.
options.feedback: He invited you somewhere, not to a debate. This one will get around the workshop.

steps.speaker: Compañero
steps.es: Es a las diez. Va a estar bueno.
steps.en: It is at ten. It is going to be good.

options.es: Fijate que ese domingo andamos donde la familia de ella.
options.en: The thing is, that Sunday we are at her family's.
options.feedback: Fijate plus a reason that is not about him. Nobody loses anything.

options.es: Es que ese día no puedo.
options.en: The thing is I cannot that day.
options.feedback: The right shape. A no with nothing named behind it sounds like what it is.

options.en: On Sundays I do not do anything.
options.feedback: You have just told him you are free. Now the no has to be a real one.

options.en: Let me know when it is, and we will see.
options.feedback: The door stays open without a promise in it. Everybody here reads that correctly.
The polite no, and he will hear it as one. That is fine if you meant it.

options.en: Yes, next Sunday I will come.
options.feedback: A yes you do not mean costs more than a no. Next Sunday will arrive.

steps.speaker: Compañero
steps.en: Right then. I will let you know.

options.feedback: Closed warmly, and the de verdad makes the thanks real rather than a formula.
It ends it. He put himself out and got one word.

options.es: No te preocupés, no voy a ir.
options.en: Do not worry, I am not going to go.
options.feedback: You just said the no out loud after both of you had carefully avoided it.
